title: Donut-shaped UFOs above Rossi's old house

tellings.quote: my old house there were there were a few that would be above it above the house.

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2025, says that at his old house a few unidentified flying objects showed up above the home over a span of about five years. He says they were donut-shaped and that his father saw them too, which, if true, would mean the family had repeated close sightings.
